title: cynanchica gussonei
intro: Cynanchica gussonei, commonly known as Yellow Milkweed, is a plant species in the Apocynaceae family, native to the Iberian Peninsula. The health benefits of Cynanchica gussonei include its potential to treat various conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antitussive properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate respiratory issues, making it a promising treatment for bronchitis and other respiratory conditions. Bioactive constituents of Cynanchica gussonei include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
